title: Stable Influence of a Uniform Function Average
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite nonempty index set, let $\rho\in[0,1]$, and let $f_j:\{\pm1\}^q\to\mathbb R$ be a family of functions indexed by $j\in\iota$. For every coordinate $i$, the stable influence at parameter $\rho$ of their pointwise uniform average is at most the uniform average of their stable influences at that coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: A family of real-valued functions on $\{\pm1\}^q$
